verdict: PASS_DIAGNOSIS_SOURCE_ONLY. M1956 is permanently FAILED_OR_INCOMPLETE_DO_NOT_CITE. Stopping the live simulation after approximately 15 minutes was conservative and correct: VCS advanced to 592502218500 simulation-time units while producing no PASS, timeout, assertion failure, or phase token, and the final sealed log records an external interrupt. Static control-flow proves the first 300000-clock watchdog is unreachable until load_workload returns. The only unbounded operation before that watchdog is the shared-valid loop that requires base.load_accept and tsbg.load_accept on the same clock. This dual-instance active-region driver is unsafe: one side can accept while the other does not, but the TB neither latches the first acceptance nor drops valid for that side, so the conjunction can never recover and the accepted side can subsequently fail closed on an out-of-sequence descriptor. A separate compile-log defect is also proven: VCS explicitly ignored global_finish_maxfail=1 because it was placed at compile time although it is runtime-only. The failure and attempt namespaces remain double-sealed, the success namespace is absent, the owned work/lock and M1956 processes are gone, and docs/359 is unchanged. Only an additive successor TB source implementing per-side valid, latched accept, bounded per-load watchdogs, race-free drive/sample phases, and phase tokens is authorized now. RTL, adapter, SVA, frozen predecessors, runner, release, license, VCS, simv, DC, PT, PPA, speedup, and paper claims remain unauthorized.

sealed_failure_audit.stop_assessment: The owner-side interrupt was not premature. The directed workload is only B4 x G12 x two halves x six slices; more decisively, the final simulated time is roughly 197.5 million 3-ns clocks, over 658 times the intended 300000-clock watchdog. Its absence proves that watchdog was never armed.
sealed_failure_audit.attempt_counter_note: The consumed-attempt directory was sealed before license/VCS by design and still says observed=0. It is budget/freshness evidence, not the authoritative execution census; the sealed compile and sim logs prove one compile and one sim invocation.

deadlock_control_flow_proof.proof: Reset is finite, then the initial thread calls load_workload. The fork containing the first watchdog occurs only after that task returns. The final time advanced by about 197.5 million clocks without the 300000-clock fatal. Therefore the initial thread never reached the fork and the only unbounded construct in the called task is the same-cycle dual-accept loop.
deadlock_control_flow_proof.primary_mechanism: One shared load_valid and shared payload drive two DUT instances, but the TB advances a descriptor after observing a combinational same-cycle conjunction and does not separately remember each DUT acceptance. Active-region driving at posedge can let one instance consume a descriptor before the other, or any later divergence can split acceptance. The already-accepted side then sees valid remain asserted for a descriptor inconsistent with its advanced expected context/group and can enter sticky ST_FAULT. Once either side has accepted without the other in that exact clock, the TB's required conjunction is no longer recoverable.
deadlock_control_flow_proof.schedule_mode_note: SCHEDULE_MODE does not change the combinational ST_LOAD acceptance equations, so the sealed run lacks enough observability to assign the first split to a particular mode or descriptor. The bug is the TB's simultaneous-accept assumption across independently stateful instances, not a proven RTL schedule-mode functional defect.
deadlock_control_flow_proof.later_join_any_orphan_watchdog: The two completion forks use join_any without disable fork. This was not reached in M1956, but an additive successor must prevent orphan watchdog threads from firing after a completed phase.

minimum_additive_tb_successor_specificat.base_identity: Copy exact M1942 TB SHA fc2340ec6cf23a3537fc63b829c26e32d2dec847dd6aa73a5aa9178f6d686a7c to a new additive path; do not modify M1942 in place.
separate_valid_signals: Connect each DUT and its unchanged SVA instance to its own valid signal.
Keep the payload shared and bit-identical, but hold it stable until both sides have independently accepted the descriptor.
latched_accept_protocol: For every descriptor, initialize base_pending=1 and tsbg_pending=1.
Sample each side's load_accept independently and latch completion; never require same-cycle conjunction.
Deassert only the accepted side's valid before the next active sampling edge while the other side remains valid.
Require exactly one accept per side per descriptor and reject an accept after its pending bit cleared.
race_free_drive_sample_protocol: Drive descriptor payload and per-side valids away from the active posedge, preferably at negedge or through a clocking block with explicit output/input skew.
Do not deassert, prepare the next descriptor, and reassert valid in the same active region as the DUT posedge.
Do not change payload until both latched accepts are complete and both valids are low.
bounded_watchdogs: Add a bounded watchdog inside every descriptor load, covering full and post-reset minimal workloads. The fatal diagnostic must include phase, context, group, each valid/ready/accept/pending bit, protocol_error, and busy.
Start a whole-test watchdog before reset release or before the first load task, so no task can execute outside liveness coverage.
Replace join_any completion forks with named forks plus disable fork, or an equivalent bounded wait for both bundle_done signals, so no orphan watchdog survives a completed phase.
phase_tokens: Emit unique parseable BEGIN and END tokens for reset, full_load, full_execute, replay_attack, stale_attack, recovery_load, recovery_execute, and final_checks.
Emit a per-load timeout token before fatal; ordinary per-descriptor success logging may remain compact.
The final PASS token must remain unique and unchanged until a different-author source hammer reviews the additive TB.
must_not_change: protocol attacks and reset recovery checks

p1_findings: P1-1: the TB requires simultaneous base/TSBG load_accept on one shared valid and does not latch per-side acceptance, creating the proven pre-watchdog permanent-wait path.
P1-2: both 300000-clock watchdogs are placed after their corresponding load tasks; the first cannot detect the observed full-load hang, and join_any leaves orphan watchdog threads.
P1-3: the fail-closed global_finish_maxfail option was supplied only to VCS compile, which explicitly ignored it as runtime-only; the successor runner must place it on simv.
required_next_gate: Author one additive TB successor implementing the exact per-side-valid/latched-accept/race-free/watchdog/phase-token specification above. A different-author source hammer must prove M1880 RTL, M803 adapter, M1880 SVA, payload/reference arithmetic, attacks, ledgers, PASS token, and docs/359 remain frozen.
